description: The settings window, and the only surface that can write anything. It holds the two privileged commands: set_supervision persists a program that start_backend runs, and set_api_settings redirects the base URL every token-bearing request is built from. It can also open a link in the real OS browser (About Jarvis's source link) - a single, narrow permission, not one of the two privileged ones above. This window is created on demand and does not exist until the user opens it.
